title: UNSAFE for straining hot foods ! ! !
text:
UNSAFE for straining hot foods ! ! !. All items purchased through Amazon.
Heated 1 pouch of BARILLA Ready Pasta, Penne 8.5 oz with water in this pot, with the lid on (I like my pasta a bit softer).
When I removed the pot, pasta, water & lid from the microwave, the handle could no longer support the weight - the handle bowed ! I attempted to strain the pasta using 2 hands but ended up spilling some pasta into the sink & hot water rolled over my hand - Ouch !
The little pot DOES NOT STAND UP TO HEAT.
Worked OK to heat leftover pasta with Rao's Homemade Marinara Sauce.
The handle still bowed but since no straining was needed it worked OK.

Thank you, Amazon.

product_metadata.title: Home-X Microwave Cooking Pot with Strainer Lid
features: FAST & EASY - Our convenient microwave pot can be used to cook everything from fresh or frozen vegetables to your favorite macaroni.

PERFORATED LID - Perforated lid fits over the pot, allowing liquids to drain freely while keeping solids contained. Lid has two different sizes on either side to let you choose quick or slow drainage.

POURING SPOUT & 2 SIZE DRAINAGE HOLES - The spouted sides ensure controlled pouring, and the lid has two different sizes on either side, allowing you to choose best drainage option for the delicious items you have cooked.
DETAILS - Holds 4 cups. Overall about 10.5" by 3.25". Crafted from durable polypropylene. BPA free.
